content:
Clara (Finance): Flagging INV-2026-5580 for EU customer NovusHealth. They were billed platform fee + 20% VAT on their private deployment renewal but contract and signed DPA indicate reverse-charge applies. Customer requests corrected invoice for their audit.

Marta (Billing): Can you paste the invoice lines? Need to confirm how VAT was applied.

Clara (Finance): From the invoice XML export:
```
INV-2026-5580
  - private_vpc | Platform fee (annual) | €48,000.00
  - VAT 20%                                   | €9,600.00
  - Total                                     | €57,600.00
```
Customer account has billing_country=SE and VAT id DE123456789. DPA indicates reverse-charge eligible.

vat-bot: Tax check: customer VAT id appears valid. Reverse-charge should be applied when supplier and customer are both VAT-registered in EU and supply is cross-border. Flag: VAT applied incorrectly.

Oleg (Tax): Confirming: with a valid VAT id and B2B private deployment (customer-hosted private_vpc) we should invoice net and include note "reverse-charge: VAT to be accounted by recipient". Looks like our invoicing exporter used billing_country and defaulted to applying VAT for private_vpc because of a product flag misread.

Yusuf (Sales): NovusHealth uploaded VAT documentation during renewal and Sales attached it to the opportunity. Shouldn't have been taxed. This will fail their audit if not corrected quickly.

Marta (Billing): Since invoice is paid, we'll need to issue a replacement invoice without VAT. Process: create credit note CN-2026-0201 reversing INV-2026-5580, then create INV-2026-5580-R with net amount €48,000 and memo "Reverse-charge applied per customer VAT id DE123456789". Need Tax + Finance sign-off. Also we need to avoid refunding the VAT if customer prefers payment to be re-applied to new invoice.

Clara (Finance): Approve replacement invoice flow. We'll reapply the paid amount to the replacement invoice so no refund is needed. Make sure the credit note explicitly states VAT was charged in error.

Oleg (Tax): Approve. Keep the original invoice in records for audit trail but mark as superseded. Include tax note and reference to the customer's VAT validation check. Also add internal ticket TAX-2026-77 to update exporter logic.

Katerina (Customer Success): I'll notify the customer that we're issuing a corrected invoice and that no additional payment is required. They asked for the internal ticket and a short explanation for their auditors. Please include the VAT validation evidence in the reply.

Marta (Billing): Creating CN-2026-0201 and INV-2026-5580-R now. Memo: "Credit for VAT charged in error; replacement invoice applies reverse-charge per validated VAT id DE123456789. Reference TAX-2026-77." ETA ~24h to post and reapply payment.

vat-bot: CN-2026-0201 created and applied; INV-2026-5580-R generated. Payment applied to new invoice.

Clara (Finance): Quick follow-up: while working this, I noticed the renewal worksheet also applied a 5% loyalty discount and Billing applied a 10% promo on top of that, resulting in double discounting that the contract does not authorize. That explains a lower net than expected on the replacement invoice.

Yusuf (Sales): Oh — Sales-approved loyalty 5% only. Where did the 10% promo come from? We did not authorize a promo for NovusHealth.

Marta (Billing): The promo code was auto-applied by the promotions engine because the account matched a segment "early-adopter" from an old experiment. Billing should have checked for contract overrides. I'll remove the promo and update the replacement invoice total accordingly. This will create a small additional debit.

Oleg (Tax): Careful. Any adjustment must be communicated and consented by customer. If we increase the replacement invoice after reapplying payment, we either invoice the delta or issue a refund flow differently. Prefer we reissue another corrected replacement invoice if necessary and transparently explain the change.

Clara (Finance): Agreed. Let's do this: remove the unintended 10% promo before finalizing the replacement invoice. If payment amount changes, we'll produce a single corrected replacement invoice reflecting contractual discounts only. Marta do you have a way to regenerate INV-2026-5580-R before reapplying payment?

Marta (Billing): Yes — rolling back the promo application and regenerating. Filing ticket BILL-9613 to prevent promo auto-apply on contract-bound accounts. Regenerating invoice now.

vat-bot: Invoice INV-2026-5580-R v2 generated: net €45,600 (after 5% loyalty discount), VAT 0 (reverse-charge note included), total €45,600. Payment applied.

Katerina (Customer Success): Customer confirmed receipt of corrected invoice and audit memo. They also asked for a signed copy of the VAT validation; attached to their account. They are satisfied.

Clara (Finance): Great. Closing actions: BILL-9613 (ban promo on contract-bound accounts) + TAX-2026-77 (exporter reverse-charge fix) + add a renewal QA check to ensure promotions and tax rules align with contract terms. Thanks everyone.
